description.text: 1. Teaching Objectives After graduation you will be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth. 2. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Fluid Mechanics, Foundation of Materials Engineering, Engineering Drawing, Foundation of Mechanical Designing, Electrotechnics & Electronic Techniques, Computer Program Design, and Control Engineering, Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics 3. Internship Metalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc. 4. Duration 2.5 years(Note: It may vary from 2 to 4 years) 5. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Mechnical EngineeringbyNortheastern University 6. Future Career After graduation you can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute. You can also go to university to make search in the major.

duration.text: The Mechnical Engineering at Northeastern University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for duration of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 35. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have bachelor degree or will get bachelor degree by September 2015
